caption: These easy protein boost tofu balls are very popular blw snacks in Korea 👀♥️ Here’s the recipe: You need one pack of firm tofu, rice flour, and veggies of your choice (or you can skip veggies). I used beets, carrots and spinach for colors! ♥️🧡💚 You can add some cheese as well. 1. Remove excess water from tofu, pat it dry with paper towel. 2. Cut tofu into 4 pieces. 3. Add one piece of tofu into blender with 3 tablespoons of rice flour and a handful (~1/4 cup) of veggies. 3. Blend until you get to doughy texture. 4. Repeat 2&3 with the remaining pieces of tofu. 5.  Turn them into bite sized ball shapes. 6. Bake at 325F for 10-15 min, or until the surface becomes non-sticky.  I also added some parmesan cheese to enhance flavor, but it’s entirely optional!  . . . #blw#babyledweaning#tofurecipes#veganrecipes#vegancooking#cooking#cookwithme#toddlersnacks#healthysnacks#easyrecipes#babyfood#toddlerfood#toddlermenu#kidsbreakfast#nycmom#momtips#momhacks
